'''Kumumgah language''' was the [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the [[Kumumgah/Legends|Kumumgah]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was the ancestor of the [[Jawaese/Legends|Jawaese]] and [[Tusken/Legends|Tusken]] languages.<ref name="Travel Guide" />
